The archived HTML file is the shared source page. Only identification facts explicitly present in that page are supported; detailed technical specifications require separate model-specific sources.

Do not treat this source as a complete technical specification sheet. Model-specific Apple technical-specification pages have been discovered for some models and remain to be archived and mapped individually.

sections.heading: iPod shuffle
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Control Pad
Capacity: 512 MB and 1 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1112: January 2005
iPod shuffle is smaller than iPod mini and has no display. There are LED lights on the front and back. The capacity of the drive is engraved on the front USB connector.
